nodes.label: Lifecycle Adapter Boundary
nodes.rationale: Lifecycle adapters translate host events into injection, eviction and pause moments while capture, archive, distillation, Memory, Recall and Manage stay host-neutral; the host that fired the boundary is the default reasoner.

nodes.label: Executor Dialect Boundary
nodes.rationale: A dialect translates a prompt and tool posture into one headless host invocation and normalizes only its final answer; every dialect switches the host's own memory off so scores stay attributable.

nodes.label: OpenCode Layered Capture via Plugin
nodes.rationale: OpenCode emits no end-of-session event, so a plugin layers prompt-admission injection, periodic and tool-driven capture, and compaction eviction, with startup backfill recovering a close before any flush; events carry full history and the watermark archives each increment once.

nodes.label: Muse mem-muse Managed Launcher
nodes.rationale: SDK apps point museBin at the managed launcher that owns the muse serve process, an isolated configuration and the OpenRouter bridge for one invocation, so users never manage a backend and detached distillation never recurses.
